records.centralDecision: Use decay at both infinities to select the zero energy orbit, prove the positive profile and its unique turning amplitude, then integrate its fourth-power mass.
records.nearestNeighbor: A nonlinear period is a closed positive-energy orbit; this orbit is nonperiodic and selected by two asymptotic boundary conditions.
